Fuzzer harness for parsing ipecho client responses.

# Purpose
This file defines a libFuzzer entry point for the `fd_ipecho_client` response parser. [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) disables log backtraces, starts the `fd` runtime with `fd_boot`, and registers `fd_halt` to run at exit. [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) passes each input buffer to `fd_ipecho_client_parse_response` and stores the parsed shred version in `shred_version`. The file also checks that the target uses a hosted environment with `FD_HAS_HOSTED`.
